items.title: /o/ Auto: Did you know that pouring vodka into your engine makes you go faster?
items.content_text: It's called Indirect Water/Ethanol Injection. It injects a mixture of water and alcohol into the intake manifold which cools down the air that gets hot in the turbo. Cooling the air down increases its pressure and you go faster. It's used in a few interesting builds like 630 hp Audi RS3 (400 hp stock) or 1000 hp RS7 (630 hp stock).

items.title: /g/ Technology: 0 rpm fans
items.content_text: I just found out that most pwm noctua fans (maybe other brands too) can go down to 0 rpm. The quick specs are usually something like min 300 max 1500 rpm, but under performance specifications there's a Rotational speed @ 0% PWM. My cpu fan header in the bios doesn't allow less than 20%, but the chassis fans can all be set to 0%. I couldn't get my temps where I wanted with the fans cutting off, but it did work.
